nativePlatform.material: NSGlassEffectView grouped in NSGlassEffectContainerView when macOS 26 APIs are available; graphite fallback otherwise.

components.name: Page destination
components.description: Three grouped native AppKit buttons, each 112×28 pt with 8 pt gaps: Battery, System, Storage. The selected page gets a filled segment, not an underline. Source: pkg/gui/native_popover.m.

components.name: Battery action
components.description: 44 pt native AppKit action with title and 10.5 pt subtitle. Unavailable heat moves to a Settings explanation; Keep Awake expands to 320 pt and Glass backing tracks the visible actions. Source: pkg/gui/native_popover.m.

components.name: Energy flow
components.description: Native-drawn closed flow silhouette with accessible charge-limit slider and visibility/Reduce-Motion-aware Core Animation highlight. Source: pkg/gui/native_power_flow.m.

components.name: Consumer row
components.description: 34 pt native row: application icon, name, two right-aligned tabular readings, and an allowed normal Quit action. Six rows maximum. Source: pkg/gui/native_popover.m.

components.name: Storage review
components.description: Embedded 400×450 pt Storage page: explicit Scan/Cancel/Rescan, Applications/App caches segments, name search, real macOS app icons and 44 pt native rows. Review opens inline details with a selectable full path and Show in Finder. Complete logical sizes are measured; partial/unknown sizes stay labeled. Inventories /Applications and ~/Applications to one vendor-folder level (up to 200 apps); exact uniquely mapped third-party ~/Library/Caches/<bundle-id> paths appear only after complete discovery. Metadata/basic code-signing classification does not fully validate bundle resources. UI says Read-only · Removal unavailable; leaving cancels and clears results. Source: pkg/gui/native_cleanup_view.m and pkg/cleanup/applications.go.

components.name: Keep Awake diagnostics
components.description: Separate stacked native diagnostics panel with semantic status/error labels and selectable monospaced report. Source: pkg/gui/native_awake_window.m.

narrative.overview:
WattNook is an operable energy overview, not a stack of equally weighted controls: read charge and state first, follow the source-to-destination energy trace, then choose a deliberate action or deeper destination. The compact native surface stays quiet, spacious, and precise. It uses real AppKit Liquid Glass where available; it is not an HTML glass treatment.

The Battery, System, Settings, History, Storage review, and Keep Awake diagnostics all use native controls and platform typography. The full visual system replaces the former 360×480 visual guidance; behavior remains unchanged, including saved palettes/menu units, unavailable heat protection, and Keep Awake's `noScreenOff` policy.
keyCharacteristics: One headline state, three explicit destinations, and a directional energy trace.
SF Pro with tabular readings; semantic labels over decorative color.
A 24 pt inset and 4 pt rhythm make a small native utility legible.

rules.name: Semantic-First
rules.body: Do not replace AppKit semantic colors with fixed HTML approximations; appearance, accessibility, and the selected palette must remain live.

rules.name: Measurement
rules.body: Preserve tabular digits and whole-machine CPU normalization; do not turn compact units, unavailable values, or updating states into invented zeroes.

rules.name: Destination
rules.body: Page navigation is a filled selection; underline-like treatment is not reused for it. Battery, System, History, Settings, Storage review, and diagnostics stay distinct destinations rather than being compressed into one scroll.

rules.name: Glass-Is-Platform
rules.body: Do not claim a browser backdrop filter or a CSS shadow reproduces this material. Keep runtime Glass availability checks and the graphite fallback.

dos: Do keep 24 pt margins and the 4 pt rhythm in the popover.
Do place every watt label outside the energy ribbon and name the source/destination.
Do use the selected palette only for selection and energy; reserve green/orange for actual status.
Do preserve visible-only, Reduce-Motion-aware flow animation and native focus/accessibility paths.
Do retain Limit unavailable, unavailable heat, and telemetry-updating states as explicit truthful content.
donts: Don't reintroduce the former 360×480 layout, duplicate consumer rows on Battery, or squeeze History into System.
Don't substitute fixed HTML colors, CSS Glass, glyph icons, or a display typeface for native AppKit semantics and SF Symbols.
Don't make ribbon width a claimed quantitative power scale or draw separate ribbons with a seam.
Don't hide saved palette/menu-unit behavior, convert unavailable data to zero, or add Screen off to Keep Awake.
